patches.title: Take Target Synonyms
patches.principle: If the exact target name is not found, accept objects with similar function or name (e.g., box includes tissuebox).
patches.when_to_apply: When task specifies an object type that is not directly visible.

patches.title: Avoid Transformation Without Object
patches.principle: Do not go to cleaning, heating, or cooling appliances unless you are holding the object to transform.
patches.when_to_apply: When the task involves transforming an object and you have not yet picked it up.

patches.title: Exhaust Open Surfaces First
patches.principle: Search all open surfaces (countertops, tables, shelves) before opening any closed containers.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately visible on arrival.
